description_en: Queries the fields of a table based on the database UUID and the fully qualified name of the table
description_zh: 根据 Database UUID 和表的全限定名查询表的字段列表
name: GetAgenticTableColumn

parameters.help_en: The UUID of the database to which the table belongs. You can obtain the UUID by calling the ListAgenticDatabase or SearchAgenticDatabase operation
parameters.help_zh: 表所属 Database 的 UUID。可通过 ListAgenticDatabase 或 SearchAgenticDatabase 获取
parameters.name: database_uuid

parameters.help_en: The fully qualified name of the table. You can obtain the name from the QualifiedName parameter returned by the ListAgenticTableBaseInfo operation. You must specify the complete name
parameters.help_zh: 表的全限定名，可通过 ListAgenticTableBaseInfo 返回的 QualifiedName 获取。需传入完整名称
parameters.name: table_qualified_name

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when a request exception occurs
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码，请求异常时返回

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：

true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
